newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Geo sees strong '96 results.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Geo sees strong '96 results.

text.p: Mexico's Corporacion Geo, a builder of public housing, expects that its 1996 results will show profits of close to 120 million pesos, company directory Miguel Gomez-Mont said.
"We're finishing working on our numbers, which should come in around 120 million pesos," Gomez-Mont told reporters.
He said Geo posted a solid performance despite the economic crisis hit Mexico in 1995.
"In '95, we sold the same number of house that we did in '94 and in '96 we could grow close to 50 percent," Gomez-Mont said.
He estimated a growth in revenue of 35 percent this year.
Geo "has grown at a dizzying pace, not just in Mexico, but also in our South American operations, especially in Chile and Colombia," he said.
